verdicts.reason: Both leave a large empty blurred-brown photo panel and shrink the hero product bag into a thumbnail, which loses the original's key image. A puts the CTA in the top-right corner above the headline, so the reading order is backwards, and the subcopy is jammed under the headline. Its badge, bag and logo float as scattered fragments, but the bag and logo are still recognisable. B's CTA and SAVE badge sit on random offsets that don't line up with the text's left edge. B also breaks the headline with an orphaned 'repeat', and its bag and logo are shrunk to illegible icons, so the brand is all but gone, which makes it the weaker of the two.
